# cb:b441

> Sub-agent delegation is permissible specifically for adjudication tasks - reviewing a session's proposed beliefs against the current graph, producing merge/reject decisions with reasons. Adjudication has bounded input, bounded output, and the working-out is itself the artifact, so no understanding is hidden from the user. Do not extend this carve-out to other classes of work (research, refactoring, design, plan execution) without an explicit new belief justifying it.

**Type:** prescription · **Kind:** rule · **Domain:** dev · **Status:** active
